Name: Desaturated Lumisteria Tilesheets
Author: itstern
Description:
This mod uniformly desaturates all of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lumisteria?gameId=1303]Lumisteria[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9599]Indoor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Outdoor[/url] tilesheets for a softer look and better compatibility with popular recolors. Other mods that edit the tilesheets will take priority over this one, so you can mix and match. Think of this mod as a catch-all for anything that isn't affected by another recolor mod. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLgTcMBt/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Should be compatible with all mods, including major expansions. 

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can turn desaturation on or off (default on) for either version.

This was specifically made to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/herbivoor?gameId=1303]Herbivoor[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url] (significant preset). I recommend using both!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjYhfz5/troubleshooting.png[/img]

No known issues yet, but please let me know if you run into anything.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0Q5sgrsb/my-mods.png[/img]﻿
